# CANDIDATE: VIX_CONFIRMATION_TIGHTEN_20

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring VIX >= 20.0 at entry for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON will filter out low-VIX bearish signals that tend to produce false breakdowns, thereby increasing edge on J winner days (which occurred during elevated VIX) and reducing losses on loser days (which often occurred in low-VIX chop). The VIX confirmation already exists as a soft condition (rising or above 20); tightening to a fixed threshold should improve specificity.

## Mechanism

In the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup evaluation, after the existing context filters (time, structure, ribbon flip, confluence, volume, news, loss budget, ribbon spread), add a hard filter: `if vix_now < 20.0: skip entry`. Use the same VIX quote source as the existing confirmation (real-time snapshot from data provider). No changes to contract selection, stop, or target logic.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% of headline P&L (due to 50% per-trade risk cap and min 3 contracts).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 6 J anchor days; selection method = fixed source-of-truth days from OP-16; overfit risk is high because tuning to these six days may not generalize.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed yet).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA slippage check on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: skipping a large winner (e.g., 5/04) if VIX <20, turning a +$730 trade into $0.
   - Max drawdown: consecutive skipped winners could produce a drawdown exceeding baseline.
   - Blow-up scenario: entering on low VIX (<20) despite filter failure (data error) could increase losses if low VIX correlates with choppy reversals.
6. **Concentration:** If the filter passes only on 1-2 of the J days, those days could represent >100% of the edge_capture (i.e., top-5 days >100% of P&L).
